# Portfolix v0.1.12 (Build 24)
- 新增“更新持仓”，快速核对份额和成本，支持成本暂不确定。 - 修复增持及校准后的今日收益计算，改善撤销和备份恢复。 - 持仓新增成本价列，统一表单与日期选择器，支持双击查看记录详情。 - 优化 AI 回答与引用展示，完善 AI／MCP 的持仓校准支持。
新版备份需使用 v0.1.12 或更高版本恢复。
## What's New
- Added holding reconciliation for quick quantity and cost updates, including unknown costs. - Fixed daily P&L after additions and reconciliation; improved reversals and backup recovery. - Added unit cost, consistent forms and date pickers, and double-click activity details. - Improved AI answers, citations and reconciliation data in AI/MCP tools.
New backups require v0.1.12 or later to restore. Apple Silicon · macOS 15+
